description.text:
A special set for the 20th anniversary of Pokémon, released on 22 February 2016, a few days before its Japanese counterpart, with 115 cards: 83 and the 32-card Radiant Collection, the second of its kind, with jewels in its artwork and frames and holo patterns across the card. It follows a Trainer's journey from the first partner Pokémon to the toughest battles, with new cards, reprints of classic cards and new cards with classic artwork, 16 Pokémon-EX and Mega Venusaur, Charizard and Blastoise.

There were no booster boxes and no loose packs: its packs came only in special collections, boxes and tins sold through the anniversary year.
